# Brief

Outcome: cut the median time a support agent needs to resolve a ticket from 14 to 9 minutes within two quarters. Evidence: 12 observed sessions (docs/research/sessions.md) show agents re-typing order data. Diagnosis: the order screen and the ticket screen are separate. Policy: show order data inside the ticket. Risks: agents may not trust auto-filled data; tested in prototype A with 6 agents, no objections.

# Brief

Diagnosis: churn is concentrated in accounts that never connect a second data source (interviews with 9 churned customers, docs/research/churn.md). Guiding policy: make the second connection the first-week goal. Actions: guided onboarding step and a day-3 email nudge. Metric: 60% second-source within 7 days, up from 31%. Risk: nudges may annoy; A/B test on 10% of new accounts first.
